name: [NEW!] My Planet Tycoon 🌎
desc:
🪐 Welcome to My Planet! 🪐
Turn your cold, desolate planet into a tropical paradise! 🏝️ Unlock tons of awesome futuristic vehicles! 🚁 Build up an arsenal of epic sci-fi guns, swords, and other weapons! ⚔️ Fight and defend your base from aliens! 👽 Mine rare ores with your mining laser gun! 💥 Visit your friends planets!

Update 2:
🪐 Planet 2 has been added!

How to Play:
💎 Mine rare ores with your laser gun 💎
💰 Sell them at your ore conveyor 💰 
🤖 Buy robots to automate mining 🤖
🚁 Unlock tons of vehicles 🚁
⚔️ Buy epic weapons ⚔️
👽 Defend your base from aliens 👽
⚡ Buy solar panels to power your machines⚡

Terraform your planet:
1. Buy atmosphere generators to turn the sky blue 🌎
2. Buy water generators to create lakes 🌊
3. Buy grass generators to turn sand into grass 🌱
4. Buy tree generators to make trees grow 🌳

⏰ You earn income when offline!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
🐛 If you encounter any bugs, post it on the group forum!

Inspired by Planet Crafter ✨
